task: 协作、团队、群、渠道、设备、电脑会话的任务层级与格式塔布局改造
beforeMechanism: Vite loads the exact six production TSX files from baselineCommit through git show; same current fixture data and shared base controls as after. No Photoshop or mock UI screenshot.
boundary: Synthetic native receipts; actual browser rendering of production components. No Android, real pairing, account login, message delivery, paid model execution, remote file write or native lease verification claim.

matureSources.name: BoardUI settings, fields, Accordion, Button
matureSources.adaptation: Reuse the existing controlled primitives; add workspace-specific composition and dialog interiors, keep labels, native handles, consent gates and reduced-motion lifecycle.

matureSources.name: Affect AIAnswer
matureSources.adaptation: Reuse existing result/message body, on the continuous main reading surface. No new card scaffold or independent-reproduction Pro code introduced.

designRules.proximity: labels stay with fields; related controls 8–12px; independent sections24–32px
designRules.commonRegion: one primary reading region, one contextual region on wide screens; no every-paragraph cards
designRules.similarity: object row titles, true status and trailing affordances share alignment; settings retain adopted primitives
designRules.continuity: continuous result/message/event reading, original Back and draft ownership retained
designRules.mobile: existing16px page inset, one-column fields; sheets stay within viewport
designRules.motion: existing BoardUI reduced-motion behavior retained; no new animation loop or execution effect

browser.status: passed for every scene via explicit expected object, active non-inert layer and stable frames
assertions: all browsing routes preserve no-send/no-confirm/no-approve boundary
start and member/native-review confirmation remains disabled before explicit consent
team reply textarea retains local draft without sending
remote draft is writable locally when permitted; hidden native window removes or disables saving/sending
Every scene has a unique expected object, heading, field or native receipt; no heading-shell-only capture.
Target must be visible, outside hidden/inert/aria-hidden ancestors, in the top active dialog when applicable, and have stable animation-frame geometry.
afterSegments: first 30 phone scenes from completed unique-object checks before the recorded later timeout

priorFailure.failure: After grant-review Back, a full synthetic journey timed out locating stop-active-connection. No source or fixture identity changed to bypass it.
priorFailure.followup: Exact devices-only browser journey passed all 16 scene/viewport pairs unchanged; baseline/current production-hook diagnostic preserved detail + stop CTA and discarded only the original grant handle.

limitations: Synthetic native receipts and real production React components only; no Android/native execution, pairing, OAuth, model billing, real remote writes or real preview tunnel claim.

One initial full-after device selector timeout was not reproduced by the unchanged focused device journey; retained in the evidence attempts record. Final scene evidence is assembled from explicit successful segments.
